To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present two privacy-friendly loyalty systems that are suitable to be used in e-commerce.
we present two privacy-friendly loyalty systems for online vendors which are based on the idea that loyalty points are issued to customers without linking the points to the purchases of the customer.
a privacy-friendly loyalty program can be realized by means of a token-based or a counter-based approach, which is much more effective in terms of efficiency and privacy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question how to improve customer retention in e-commerce through a secure and privacy-enhanced loyalty system.
the development of privacy-enhanced loyalty systems which are secure against attacks by vendors, customers and third parties.
the design, implementation, evaluation, and analysis of two privacy-friendly loyalty systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our proposed loyalty systems provide a secure, privacy-preserving, and efficient solution to the problem of customer retention in e-commerce.
the counter-based loyalty scheme is superior to the token-based one, since it offers the same privacy and security properties while being much more efficient.
the counter-based loyalty approach is the most suitable one for e-commerce applications.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
our loyalty system is privacy-friendly, efficient and secure.
we provide two secure, privacy-friendly loyalty systems that can be used by online shops to reward customers and thus improve customer retention.
our loyalty system allows vendors to reward loyal customers while preventing them from exploiting customer data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presented loyalty systems allow vendors to reward customers for their purchases without the need to compromise the privacy of customers.
the counter-based loyalty scheme can be used as a privacy-friendly alternative to traditional loyalty systems.
the counter-based loyalty scheme can be used by online retailers to turn privacy sensitive customers into loyal customers.
